name: Care plan from intake
summary: Takes a new patient from the practice system, drafts a care plan note from the clinic's own template for a clinician to finish, and queues the intake assessment form for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every form sent and a clinician signs off every note.

clinic-intake-to-plan.evidence: 0 discovery calls describe this way of working; built from the Cliniko help centre pages (docs read)

covered_by.intake-received: intake cron (reads new patients and their referral source)
covered_by.intake-assessment: live op queued for approval (intake form)
covered_by.eligibility-check: skill (judges the referral's issue and expiry dates)
covered_by.plan-draft: draft (care plan note from the clinic template, draft: true)
covered_by.clinician-review: manual in Cliniko (the clinician finalises the note)
covered_by.plan-sent: live op queued for approval (form create)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New patients from the lookback window, with each one's referral source.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Draft a care plan note from the clinic template for each new patient, and queue the intake form for approval.

crons.name: forms
crons.summary: Record which approved intake forms the patient has completed.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the clinic: reads, and a treatment note saved as a draft (draft: true) that only the clinic can see until a clinician finalises it. Creating a patient form is live: it reaches a patient, so a cron can only queue it.

cliniko.covers: new patients, referral source, care plan note draft, intake form queued for approval, form completion

gaps: Cliniko has no care plan document, goals, funding or eligibility check, clinician sign-off, team allocation or plan review in the docs read: those steps are skill work or manual until a live account shows otherwise.
Client consent: the docs say patients accept the privacy policy when booking online, but no consent endpoint is mapped for an intake consent record, so consent is not covered.
Whether creating a patient form emails the patient is not stated in the API spec, so the form create stays in live_ops and a person sends it from Cliniko if it does not.
Splose (the second platform in the evidence) has no mapping in the kit: its help centre was read, but there is no ops.json or adapter, so it is not built.
The Cliniko list filter (created_at on q[]) and the treatment note template behaviour are tested offline only; a live Cliniko account is needed to confirm them.
Zero owner calls describe this workflow, so the steps come from the vendor help centre, not from how clinics run intake.

evidence.calls: 0 health care calls describe care plans from intake (the variants file has no steps)
